mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical SMI Ergodic line/signal crossover identifies a reversal in double-smoothed signed momentum relative to double-smoothed absolute momentum; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when SMI crosses strictly above its signal EMA; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: SMI Ergodic divides double-EMA signed close change by the identically double-EMA absolute close change and crosses that bounded ratio against its own EMA. It is not a price-average crossover, return sum, range path, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse normalized double-smoothed momentum/signal reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.change: completed close minus previous completed close
features.event: current finite nonzero SMI-signal sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical SMI Ergodic(5,20,5) line crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no periods, initialization, guides, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: canonical SMI Ergodic / True Strength Index convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: change and absolute change each receive EMA(5) then EMA(20); SMI is their ratio; signal is EMA(5) of SMI
external_basis.selection_use: published defaults 5,20,5 and line crossover only; no guides, incidence, or outcomes
